content: Open Monday to Saturday, 06:00 to 13:00. Closed on Sundays and on the first three days of Lunar New Year. 營業時間：週一至週六 06:00–13:00，週日公休。
Last order is at 12:30. Iron-plate noodles stop at 12:00 because the grill is cleaned. 最後點餐 12:30，鐵板麵 12:00 停售。
No. 58, Zhuoyue Road, Nanzih District, Kaohsiung (高雄市楠梓區卓越路58號), a 3-minute walk from the NKUST First Campus back gate.
07-123-4567. We answer the phone during opening hours only.
We take cash and LINE Pay. We do not take credit cards.
We have 20 seats. During the busy time (07:00–08:00) please keep dine-in to 30 minutes. Free Wi-Fi: password is on the counter.
Order in advance by LINE (@morning-demo) or by phone, at least 20 minutes before pickup. Orders over NT$500 need one day's notice.
We deliver within 1.5 km on weekdays from 07:00 to 11:00. Minimum order NT$150. Delivery fee NT$30; free delivery for orders of NT$300 or more (before discounts).
Combo deal: each main item (egg crepe, toast, burger, iron-plate noodles) ordered together with a drink gets NT$10 off.
Students who show a student card get NT$10 off an order of NT$80 or more (once per order).
Bring your own cup and get NT$5 off each drink.
Add an egg (+NT$10), cheese (+NT$10) or bacon (+NT$15) to any egg crepe, toast or burger.
Our kitchen uses eggs, milk, wheat, soy and peanuts. We cannot promise any item is free of these. Ask our staff in the shop for details. 本店廚房使用蛋、奶、小麥、黃豆、花生，無法保證任何餐點不含這些成分。
Scooters can park in front of the shop. There is no car park; cars can use the paid car park on Zhuoyue Road (about 200 m away).
